zh-Hans: 支持为 SayKuku 单独选择麦克风，断连时自动回退到系统输入。
录音时显示当前麦克风与无声提示，改进麦克风测试和浮窗布局。
听写二次整理关闭思考并等待结果返回，减少长文本整理被提前跳过的情况。
扩大设置折叠标题的点击范围，句末标点说明随选项更新。
en: Choose a microphone just for SayKuku, with automatic fallback to the system input when disconnected.
Recording shows the active microphone and a quiet-input hint, with an improved microphone test and overlay layout.
Dictation refinement disables thinking and waits for the response, so longer text is less likely to skip cleanup.
Settings disclosure headers are easier to click, and ending-punctuation help follows your selection.
